newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa says 1996 profit down, sells Lauda stake. [CORRECTED 17:35 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa says 1996 profit down, sells Lauda stake. [CORRECTED 17:35 GMT]

text.p: German airline Deutsche Lufthansa AG said on Wednesday its 1996 pre-tax profit would be about 10 percent below the 1995 level of 756 million marks ($442.1 million) despite a five (corrects from 4.5) percent rise in group sales to almost 20 (corrects figure from 18.5) billion marks.

The airline also said it would reduce its stake in Austria-based Lauda Air to 20 percent from 39.7 percent in a deal with Austrian Airways, which will allow it to review possible cooperation deals with Austrian Airlines and Lauda Air as well as Tyrolean Airways of Austria.

In addition, Lufthansa said its supervisory board has approved a planned restructuring of passenger services in a bid to prepare the airline for competition expected to result form the impending liberalisation of air traffic in Europe.
